zh: 翻译仅在宿主和服务商能强制禁用工具时发送文本。当前可用的 Paseo 与服务商暂不满足条件，翻译暂不可用，设置页会说明原因。
en: Translation sends text only when the host and provider can enforce a tool-free session. Currently available Paseo hosts and providers do not meet this requirement, so translation is temporarily unavailable; Settings explains why.

zh: 恢复翻译，支持使用会话或自选的 Provider 与模型；辅助 Agent 使用该 Provider 配置的工具权限。
选中文本翻译支持跨区块选择，并保留段落换行。
归档任务时，可选择仅归档当前卡片，或连同所有子任务一起归档。
修复以 ~/ 开头的主目录路径解析。
en: Translation is available again with the conversation’s provider and model or your own selection. The helper agent uses the provider’s configured tool permissions.
Selected-text translation supports selections across blocks and preserves paragraph breaks.
Archive only the current task or include all of its subtasks.
Fix resolution of home-relative paths beginning with ~/.
